messages:
maya: Heads-up — Support flagged three separate ACME tickets that look like the same ask: per-model token cost breakdown for routed requests. One came in via support, two via sales notes. Can we consolidate into a single canonical backlog item and decide owner/next steps?

jon: Links?

maya: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-5412  
https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SALES-2331  
https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SALES-2335

sam: Skimmed the tickets — same outcome desired. Recommend we create a canonical request and mark the others as linked duplicates. Also worth checking if billing has existing work on per-model metrics.

lisa: +1 to canonicalize. Proposed acceptance criteria: (1) per-model daily usage + per-route token breakdown, (2) exportable CSV/report, (3) short-term UI row for top models. If those are satisfied we can call it MVP.

alex_sales: ACME PM called this "high visibility" for procurement. They're asking for per-model cost so they can forecast pricing tiers. I can run the comms with them once we have an owner.

support-bot: Note: Ticket SUP-5412 has label customer-ask and priority MEDIUM. Auto-linked to account ACME_CORP.

maya: Plan: I'll create a canonical ticket `ACME-202604-cost-visibility`, tag all three tickets, and add a short scope proposal. Can @alex_sales handle the initial customer update?

alex_sales: Yep, I'll let them know we're consolidating and expect an update after scoping. :thumbsup:

lisa: Ownership: assign to eng-runway for scoping. Triage score: 2.5 (customer impact + procurement urgency). Scope note: MVP = per-model/day aggregation (no per-session granularity).

jon: Adding tags: `backlog:customer-ask`, `canonical:ACME-202604`, `triage:needs-scoping`.

maya: Done — linked tickets and left internal note. Status on duplicates set to "linked -> canonical ACME-202604-cost-visibility". I'll drop the canonical ticket draft in product backlog for triage meeting.

sam: Thanks — will check for overlap with billing exports before kickoff.

lisa: Great. Alex will follow up with ACME; we'll pick up scope in next triage.
